parameters.name: DownloadDataType
parameters.description: The type of the download object. Only **TABLE** is supported.

parameters.name: EndTime
parameters.description: The end time of the time range for querying data.

parameters.name: FileConfig
parameters.description: The download file settings. Specifies a name (fileName) for the download file. The name is customizable. If fileName is not specified, a file name is generated by default.

parameters.name: IotInstanceId
parameters.description:
The instance ID. You can view the **ID** of the current instance on the **Overview** page in the IoT Platform console.

><notice>
- If an ID value is available, you must specify this ID value. Otherwise, the call fails.
- If no <props="intl"><ph>**Overview** page or </ph></props>ID value is available, you do not need to specify this parameter.

></notice>

For more information about instances, see [Overview](~~356505~~).

parameters.name: StartTime
parameters.description: The start time of the time range for querying data.

parameters.name: TableName
parameters.description: The name of the table to download.
